text: '/tmp/fake.pst' is an Outlook archive, which this build cannot read yet. | fix: PST support needs Outlook MAPI and is the outstanding half of Layer 2 - see BUILD_SPEC_V2.md. Every other file type indexes normally, and this archive is counted so it can be picked up as soon as PST lands. To index the mail now, export it to EML with XstReader and point the indexer at that folder.
